## Detailed Findings

### FINDING-001: CRITICAL - Bare Except Clauses (CORE-013 Violation)

```yaml
finding:
  id: "FINDING-001"
  agent: "cortex-review-brittleness"
  severity: "CRITICAL"
  category: "error_handling"
  rule_violated: "CORE-013"
  
  title: "Bare except clauses in production code"
  
  evidence:
    detection_command: "grep -rn 'except:' --include='*.py' src/"
    files_affected:
      - path: "src/core/audit_required_validator.py"
        lines: [160, 425]
      - path: "src/ci_cd/compliance_gate.py"
        lines: [184]
    
    code_samples:
      - file: "src/core/audit_required_validator.py:160"
        code: "except:"
      - file: "src/core/audit_required_validator.py:425"
        code: "except:"
      - file: "src/ci_cd/compliance_gate.py:184"
        code: "except:"
  
  impact:
    production_risk: "Silent exception swallowing masks errors"
    debugging_difficulty: "Stack traces lost, root cause hidden"
    data_integrity: "Potential silent corruption"
  
  remediation:
    effort: "2h"
    approach: |
      1. Replace bare except with specific exceptions
      2. Add logging for caught exceptions
      3. Re-raise or handle appropriately
    fix_pattern: |
      # BEFORE
      except:
          pass
      
      # AFTER
      except (SpecificError, OtherError) as e:
          logger.exception("Failed to process: %s", e)
          raise
  
  ac_suggested: "AC-FIX-001-01"
  priority: "IMMEDIATE - Fix before next phase"
```

### FINDING-002: CRITICAL - Hardcoded Paths in Tests (CORE-005 Violation)

```yaml
finding:
  id: "FINDING-002"
  agent: "cortex-review-assumptions"
  severity: "CRITICAL"
  category: "platform"
  rule_violated: "CORE-005"
  
  title: "Hardcoded absolute paths in test files"
  
  evidence:
    detection_command: "grep -rn '/Users/' --include='*.py' tests/"
    files_affected:
      - path: "tests/unit/tier3/test_auto_indexing.py"
        lines: [58, 64, 72, 85, 95, 105, 119, 133, 145, 163, 177, 191, 209, 226, 245, 313, 325]
        count: 17 occurrences
      - path: "tests/unit/core/intent/test_intent_reflection_protocol.py"
        lines: [47]
        count: 1 occurrence
    
    code_sample: |
      # test_auto_indexing.py:58
      knowledge_dir = Path("/Users/asifhussain/PROJECTS/CORTEX/cortex-brain/tier3/knowledge")
  
  impact:
    ci_cd_failure: "Tests will fail on any CI/CD system"
    developer_portability: "New developers cannot run tests"
    cross_platform: "Windows/Linux environments broken"
  
  remediation:
    effort: "4h"
    approach: |
      1. Replace all hardcoded paths with Path(__file__).parent patterns
      2. Use pytest fixtures for common paths
      3. Add CI/CD test to detect future violations
    fix_pattern: |
      # BEFORE
      knowledge_dir = Path("/Users/asifhussain/PROJECTS/CORTEX/cortex-brain/tier3/knowledge")
      
      # AFTER
      from src.core.path_resolver import get_project_root
      knowledge_dir = get_project_root() / "cortex-brain" / "tier3" / "knowledge"
  
  ac_suggested: "AC-FIX-002-01"
  priority: "IMMEDIATE - Blocks CI/CD"
```

  agent: "cortex-review-assumptions"

    detection_command: "grep -rn 'darwin\\|macOS' --include='*.py' src/"
    areas_of_concern:

      - "Path separators may be hardcoded in some edge cases"

  impact:

  remediation:
    effort: "4h"

      2. Verify CrossPlatformFileLock handles all platforms
      3. Add platform-specific tests to CI
  
  ac_suggested: "AC-FIX-004-01"
  priority: "Before production deployment"
